| Case | Value |
| --- | --- |
| backslash | `a\b` |
| one backtick | ``a`b`` |
| two backticks | ```a``b``` |
| leading backtick | `` `x `` |
| trailing backtick | `` x` `` |
| only backtick | `` ` `` |
| pipe | `a\|b` |
| backslash then pipe | `a\\|b` |
| padded spaces | `  x  ` |
| only spaces | `   ` |
